summary.name: RealFun Color
summary.one_liner: RealFun Color is a selfie-based personal color analysis tool that checks clothing colors against a personal color profile, but the page itself currently shows a Cloudflare 522 connection timeout error.
use_cases: determine which colors suit your complexion from a selfie
check whether a clothing item matches your personal color profile
build a color palette for shopping or wardrobe planning
summary.what_it_does: ["The page text is only a Cloudflare error screen (Error 522) saying the connection between Cloudflare and the origin web server timed out, so the site could not be displayed when this page was captured. The page text provides no details on the tool's features. The directory listing describes RealFun Color as providing selfie-based personal color analysis and checking clothing colors against a personal color profile. No other capabilities are stated on the page."]
notable: Uses a selfie to perform personal color analysis (per directory listing)
Can check clothing colors against a personal color profile (per directory listing)
caveats: The site returned a Cloudflare Error 522 timeout when this page was captured, so it may be down or unreachable
Pricing tier is taken from the directory listing tag (#freemium); the page itself does not state pricing
